If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Metronome v2: 60 MHz, the clock the demo board's RP2350 supplies.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
======== Metronome v2 place-and-route sizing additions (plain template otherwise: no timing tuning) ========
RTL: USE_IHP_SRAM selects the IHP SRAM macros in md2_pmem and md2_dmem; USE_IHP_CELLS selects the library
latch (sg13cmos5l_dlhrq_1) and clock gate (sg13cmos5l_lgcp_1, dont_use in the liberty) in cfg_latch_bank.
md2_defs.vh is included from src.
IHP SRAM macros, set up as in ttcodebot/ttihp-cmos5l-sram-example. The power-stripe step
(librelane_plugin_sram_pdn.py and odb_stripes.py at the project root) runs right after OpenROAD.GeneratePDN;
src/pdn_cfg.tcl leaves out the per-macro grid.
Floorplan kept from v1.0 (V2_DESIGN 4): two 256x64 program memories (one per core) at the right edge, the
512x32 data memory at the bottom left. x positions are 3.36 + n x 11.24 um (the macros' power-column pitch).
Program RAMs at x = 891.32 leave a 45 um channel at the core edge: at x = 925.04 pdngen channel straps between
the macro edge and the core edge were promoted to full-height stripes and shorted VPWR to VGND (v1.0 LVS, r5).
Plugin option of the SRAM stripe step: an extra VPWR/VGND pair on every other position over each bit-cell array.
pdngen checks the SRAM power before ExtendPowerStripes connects it, so errors are expected there.
Magic DRC flags macro internals; the TT precheck runs the full KLayout DRC deck on the final GDS instead.
Magic sees stripes over the macro LEF obstruction as illegal overlaps (no metal there in the GDS).
r2 (U10): v1.0's closing synthesis and repair block, unchanged from src/config.json (D19). r1 left 51
Metal3/4 shorts (congestion allowed) and -0.93 ns slow setup through an unrepaired nor3_1 (no setup margin).
r3 (U10): base SDC plus a 2-cycle setup exception on the configuration latch D pins (src/project.sdc), valid
under cfg_latch_bank's write spacing rule. Checked on r1's routed netlist: borrow 2.17 -> 0 ns, latch-launched
worst path -0.926 -> +0.998 ns (slow corner, OpenSTA, analysis only).
r4 (U10): cap transitions at 1.0 ns (base.sdc applies it as set_max_transition; the library allows 2.5 ns).
r3 failed slow setup (-1.154 ns) through drive-1 gates on 0.13-0.155 pF nets with 1.8-2.8 ns slews; the
resizer's global-route estimate saw the slow corner at +3.97 ns there (estimate vs extracted: 0.6 ns typ, 5 ns slow).
